key_impacts: Accident remains unresolved years after initial meltdown; ongoing management is required.
Approximately 400 tons of groundwater enter daily, becoming contaminated.
Site is packed with multiple 1,000-ton tanks storing contaminated water.
Continuous cooling is required to prevent further radioactive releases.
People affected continue to bear damage and complex issues.
evidence_snippets: "large-scale nuclear disaster at the TEPCO-operated Fukushima Daiichi (Number One) Nuclear Power Plant"
"directly caused by the Great East Japan Earthquake and Tsunami of March 11, 2011."
"About 400 tons of groundwater are flowing in everyday... the whole site ... packed with 1,000 ton capacity tanks containing the contaminated water."
missing_information: Impact numbers missing (casualties, displacement, economic losses).
Directly impacted offsite settlements not specified.
